entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm sorry for asking you here like this.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh no, it isn't a problem... I actually[n]find it refreshing to be asked to the[n]student council room.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Although it's somewhat nerve-racking[n]as well.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...I think I'm a bit nervous myself.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Anyway, um...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I wanted to apologize.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm... really sorry for everything.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What do you mean...?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You know how I blamed you for[n]Kamoshida's sexual harassment?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, I wanted to apologize for that...[n]I've honestly been meaning to this[n]whole time.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Takamaki-san...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I realized later that Shiho was calling out[n]for me... and I wasn't there to help her...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I didn't want to admit my own guilt...[n]so I took it out on you, Niijima-senpai.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm... very sorry.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Hey, there is no need for that.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: In fact, I think the two of us are pretty[n]similar.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I was unable to save anyone. Not Suzui-san,[n]and not any of Kaneshiro's victims.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I kept telling myself I wasn't at fault[n]because I was simply following orders...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But that was all a lie.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It felt like I would be admitting[n]my own worthlessness had I not[n]shifted the blame off of myself.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Fear of that worthlessness was[n]probably why I acted so harshly[n]toward you and your friends.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I'm deeply sorry as well.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I see...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...In that case, wanna call it even?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Even...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: *chuckle* You're right... How about we[n]leave this conversation in the past?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Mm-hm!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, but... one more thing.[n]You're not worthless, Niijima-senpai.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You were a bit reckless, but you're[n]the reason we found a way into[n]Kaneshiro's Palace.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And you even obtained the power to[n]change people's hearts. You did that[n]all yourself, Niijima-senpai.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: *chuckle* That way of thinking is[n]very much like you, Takamaki-san.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: When you confronted me about Suzui-san,[n]I realized how dishonest and small I was.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You're always very direct... That's[n]what helped me finally realize the[n]error of my ways.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It turns out I'm a little slow on the uptake[n]at times...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hey... Can I call you Ann?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Um, yeah! I... I'm going to do the same,[n]M-M-Makoto... Rgh, that's so embarrassing!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: *chuckle* How about we get[n]something to eat before we[n]go home for the night?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ooh, I know a place!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: There's a crêpe shop at Central Street that[n]totally stuffs their crêpes!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Do you want to split one?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Mmmm, let's each get a whole one and[n]then we can go half and half on those!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes, let's! After school today, right?
